description: This file defines a CacheControlAdapter class which extends the requests library's HTTPAdapter to add caching behavior, including cache lookups, cache updates, and response handling with caching heuristics for HTTP requests.

classes.name: CacheControlAdapter
classes.description: A specialized HTTPAdapter that adds cache management to HTTP requests, handling cache lookup, cache update, and cache invalidation based on HTTP methods and responses.
